@@U00091@@
Infinite Nature, where do I take hold? Where are your breasts? Those fountains that nurture all life that I so long for? Why, when they are offered to all, must | thirst in vain?

@@U00092@@
(He turns the pages impatiently and sees the symbol of the Earth Spirit.)

@@U00093@@
How differently this symbol affects me! Earth Spirit, you are closer to me. I already feel the surge of new energy warm me like wine. I’m emboldened to venture out into life, to endure the joy and pain of earth, wrestle with its storms, and never in the face of grinding shipwreck know despair. Clouds are gathering above me! The moon hiding its light! The lamp goes out! Vapors rise! Red beams dart about my head! Terror breathes down upon me from the ancient vault and seizes me! Spirit that I have sought, I feel you hovering near! Reveal yourself! Ah! It tears at my heart! All that am struggles and gropes toward new sensations! My heart is all yours! Reveal yourself!
translation:
@@U00091@@
无限的自然，我该在哪里把握？你的乳房在哪里？那些滋养我所渴望的所有生命的喷泉？为什么当它们被提供给所有人时，必须|口渴是徒然吗？

@@U00092@@
（他不耐烦地翻着书页，看到了大地之灵的标志。）

@@U00093@@
这个符号对我的影响是多么不同啊！大地之灵，你离我更近了。我已经感觉到新能量的涌动像酒一样温暖着我。我有勇气冒险进入生活，忍受尘世的欢乐和痛苦，与暴风雨搏斗，面对磨难的海难，我从不感到绝望。乌云正在我上方聚集！月亮隐藏了它的光芒！灯灭了！蒸气上升！红色光束在我的头上飞舞！恐惧从古老的墓穴中向我袭来并抓住了我！我所寻找的精神，我感觉到你在附近盘旋！展现你自己！啊!真是戳中我的心了！一切都在为新的感觉而奋斗和摸索！我的心全是你的！展现你自己！
